title: Reliable integration mock preview
description: A short original-content preview of timed mock behavior. It is not a full AIP-C01 simulation.

items.prompt: A Bedrock response parses as JSON. Which next step establishes an application data boundary?

choices.label: Validate the runtime schema and field constraints

items.rationale: Parsing proves syntax only; runtime validation establishes the data boundary.

items.prompt: Which recovery policy best bounds latency and cost?

choices.label: Retry eligible failures within a total attempt and time limit
Suppress the failure and return an empty result

items.rationale: Explicit eligibility, attempt, and time limits prevent amplified failures.

items.prompt: A model requests broader tool permissions. What should authorize the change?

choices.label: A deterministic server-side policy and authenticated principal

items.rationale: Model and client output are untrusted and cannot grant authority.

items.prompt: Which telemetry is useful while minimizing sensitive data?

choices.label: Latency, attempt count, failure category, and terminal outcome
Every prompt and raw model response

items.rationale: Operational metadata supports diagnosis without reproducing sensitive content.

items.prompt: What independently limits damage when a lab client disappears?

choices.label: Server TTL, revocation, and an independent resource sweeper

items.rationale: Server-enforced expiry and independent cleanup do not depend on client health.
